_comment: The delivery roster. Edit this file: add a role, rename one, change a day rate. Every role here gets its own pair of fitted heads (is it needed / how many days) provided the engagement corpus has a role_days column for it, plus a line on every card and its own rate in the cost. Day rates below are PLACEHOLDERS.

roles.name: Solution architect
roles.blurb: Shapes the solution and owns the technical decisions. Scales with novelty and integration surface, not with volume.

roles.name: Data scientist
roles.blurb: Model selection, evaluation design and error analysis. Needed where the answer has to be measured rather than asserted.

roles.name: Data engineer
roles.blurb: Pipelines, indexing and access to the source material. The role most often missed at scoping and most often the critical path.

roles.name: Software engineer
roles.blurb: Builds and integrates the thing. Usually the largest line.

roles.name: Security expert
roles.blurb: Threat modelling, data handling and the security review the client's own team will run anyway. Needed wherever regulated or personal data moves, which is most places.

roles.name: Industry consultant
roles.blurb: Domain and process work: what the current process is, what it should become, and what the regulator will accept.

roles.name: Project manager
roles.blurb: Plan, governance and the client relationship. Scales with coordination load rather than with build.

roles.name: Change manager
roles.blurb: Adoption, training and the operating-model change. Needed wherever the work displaces what people currently do.
